#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int h, n;
    cin >> h >> n;
    n -= 1;
    std::string binary_str;
    {
        std::string temp;
        int temp_n = n;
        if (temp_n == 0) {
            temp = "0";
        } else {
            while (temp_n > 0) {
                temp += (temp_n % 2) ? '1' : '0';
                temp_n /= 2;
            }
            std::reverse(temp.begin(), temp.end());
        }
        binary_str = temp;
    }
    // Pad with leading zeros
    if ((int)binary_str.size() < h) {
        binary_str = std::string(h - binary_str.size(), '0') + binary_str;
    }

    std::string result;
    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
        if (i > 0 && binary_str[i - 1] == '0') {
            result += (binary_str[i] == '0') ? '1' : '0';
        } else {
            result += binary_str[i];
        }
    }

    long long total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
        total += 1;
        if (result[i] == '1') {
            total += (1LL << (h - i)) - 1;
        }
    }
    cout << total << "\n";
    return 0;
}
